items.title: Secure Methods for Transmitting and Storing Data

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Secure Methods for Transmitting and Storing Data under 9.2 as printed (PDF 127-128, printed 123-124).

blocks.text: Data must be protected not only when stored on a computer but also when sent over the internet. Secure methods such as encrypted connections (like HTTPS) keep information safe during transmission. Cloud storage services also use encryption to prevent unauthorized access to saved files. Regular backups help protect data from loss caused by system failure or attacks. Following secure storage and transfer methods ensures that important data remains safe and reliable.
